title: CAVAL: A Cost-Aware Validation System for Tradable-Alpha Discovery with False Discovery Rate Control
description: Reproducible code, configurations, and processed-data artifacts for the CAVAL five-screen validation protocol: a data-integrity pre-screen (Screen 0), Benjamini-Hochberg FDR control, a permutation-calibrated Tradable-Alpha FDR test, an Alpha Robustness Volume cost-robustness metric, and a single-touch locked out-of-sample evaluation with PBO/CSCV, Deflated Sharpe Ratio, and conformal calibration. Applied to a survivorship-bias-free S&P 500 universe (2010-2024).
